Results.ReviewText: I've been a Weber kettle charcoal user for the past 40 years. I recently switched to a weber gas grill (reluctantly, as I love the charcoal flavor), for the potential convenience of a gas grill-WOW!!! No more charcoal mess, no more looking for the lighter fluid, no waiting for the coals to get hot, and being able to control the heat during cooking has made me a believer. I've cooked every night this week, and it's been so easy, and nothing gets burned! And the food tastes great!!!!!

Results.ReviewText: Have used Weber grills for over 30 years. Immediately noticed that my new grill is much lighter in metal strength and weight. Tried to rotisserie yesterday for the first time. New grill and new attachment. The 5 lb chicken was too large to spin in the cavity as Weber has downsized the cavity allowing the chicken to drag into the drip pan, with grilling grates out. Jury is still out on whether this grill will do the job all my previous Weber grills did. It appears to cook evenly when doing hamburgers, steaks, etc.

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
